india_trends.title: Bharat Coking Coal shares jump over 7%. What's behind the sharp surge?

The rally follows supply disruptions and strong long-term demand forecasts, offsetting the company's weak Q1 FY27 results where it posted a net loss of Rs 68 crore amid falling production.
